framed.note: Cutout trimmed to its alpha box and centred on white; fill is measured on the product's longest side.

compliance.note: Fill is reported both ways: longest side (the conservative reading, used for the verdict) and area. Amazon's own policy page is the authority.

how_to_judge: Open smoke_cutout_alpha.png on a dark background: edges must be clean, no halo. smoke_main_2000.png is what a listing slot gets; compliance.blockers says whether it would pass.
